launches.title: Clearline | AI native revenue engine for automotive
launches.tagline: Clearline deploys AI agents that answers every inbound call, follows up on every lead, and tracks every customer interaction for car dealerships, 24/7.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We're Adi and Abhi, the founders of Clearline.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99746&key=user_uploads/942902/e3dbee2c-c4a0-4485-ad87-4509317bb2c9)

### The Problem

Customer experience at car dealerships is broken. Not because the teams don't care, but because the systems were never built for how customers actually behave today.

Here's the reality:

* **23% of dealership calls go unanswered.** 85% of those callers never call back. That's revenue walking out the door every single day.
* **Most lead follow-up dies by day 5.** Dealerships spend thousands driving traffic and generating leads, then let them rot in a CRM nobody checks.
* **Sales uses one system. Service uses another. Nobody has the full picture.** Reps waste time on manual logging, managers guess at what's happening, and customers repeat themselves every time they call.

Dealerships have tried to solve this with more tools, more staff, more process. It doesn't work. The stack is fragmented and nothing talks to each other.

### The Solution

Clearline is an AI-native operating system for dealerships. Three products, one platform:

**Inbound** - AI answers every sales and service call instantly. No voicemail, no hold music, no transfers. It qualifies intent, routes to the right department, and books appointments in real-time. 24/7, including nights and weekends.

**Outbound** - Automated follow-up via calls, texts, and email. Clearline responds to new inquiries within seconds and runs disciplined cadences from day 1 through day 90. No lead gets forgotten.

**CRM** - One unified record across sales, service, and BDC. Full call transcripts, automatic logging, next steps triggered without anyone typing a note. Managers get complete visibility with real data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99746&key=user_uploads/942902/dd50c407-f1a1-4910-b1c3-7124bd3e294b)

### Results

Dealerships see this in their first 30 days:

* **$60K+ revenue recovered** from missed calls and dead leads
* **240% more leads engaged**
* **4+ tools consolidated** into one platform

> _"Recovered $78K in service and sales revenue from 400 missed calls per month._

> _"Show rate on outbound appointments went from 38% to 64% in the first month._

### You're Always in Control

This isn't about replacing dealership staff. Clearline augments your team:

* AI escalates to a human anytime a situation needs real judgment
* It only operates within rules you define (hours, routing, boundaries)
* It only uses dealership-approved responses for pricing and policies
* Every call, message, and booking is logged and reviewable

### Try Clearline

If you run a dealership or know someone who does, we'd love to chat.

[Book a demo](https://useclearline.com/?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=launch_yc)

Reach us directly at [founders@useclearline.com](mailto:founders@useclearline.com) or check us out at [Clearline](https://useclearline.com/?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=launch_yc)

launches.title: Lancey - connect your customer signals to your codebase
launches.tagline: Every AI coding tool writes code. Lancey helps you decide what to buid.
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Most teams know what their customers want. It’s buried in Slack threads, support tickets, and calls. But turning that into shipped code still takes months.

Lancey is the first autonomous coding agent that builds what your customers want.\
It listens to your customer channels, understands your codebase, and ships ready-to-merge PRs, all in the background.

https://youtu.be/1g76HQkrdyQ

---

### **The Problem**

Customer feedback already tells you exactly what to fix or build. The issue isn’t knowing _what_ to do, it’s the manual steps between understanding and shipping.

Support tickets, Slack threads, and bug reports pile up. Engineers spend hours triaging. Product teams chase context. PMs and devs are stuck in loops instead of shipping.

Even AI coding assistants today still need you to _prompt_ them, _explain the bug_, and _review every output_. It’s still work, just faster typing.

---

### **Why Lancey Exists**

We built Lancey because we think software should respond directly to its customers. Without human bottlenecks.

Lancey continuously scans your customer channels and codebase to spot high-impact bugs or requests. When it’s confident, it drafts and submits a PR. When it’s unsure, it asks for review.

No tickets, no triage, no context handoffs. Just a system that quietly keeps your product aligned with your users.

---

### **How It Works**

* **Understands your customer context** - Connect Slack, Zendesk, Intercom, and more.
* **Understands your code** - Builds a deep map of your repositories and dependencies.
* **Builds autonomously** - Drafts fixes, features, and improvements as ready-to-merge PRs.
* **Collaborates by default** - Keeps engineers and PMs in the loop so nothing feels like a black box.

---

### **Who It’s For**

Engineering and product teams who want to spend less time triaging and more time shipping what actually matters to customers.

---

### **Why Now**

We’ve reached a point where LLMs can not only reason over customer data, they can write safe, context-aware code. The missing piece is connecting these two worlds.

Lancey makes **customer-driven engineering autonomous**.

# **How you can get access**

* Sign up for a free account [here](https://lancey.ai)
